column1: # The checks of shell/auth87.nsh, the boot of shell-auth87: EnhancedAuthData and
# EnhancedAuthRefused have the attributes 0x87. See check-shell-log.sh.
# DmpStore names no flag for EFI_VARIABLE_ENHANCED_AUTHENTICATED_ACCESS; the data is the 68
# bytes of EFI_VARIABLE_AUTHENTICATION_3, EFI_TIME and EFI_VARIABLE_AUTHENTICATION_3_CERT_ID,
# get decodes the value behind that metadata (UEFI 2.11 §8.2.1); this firmware returns the
# set refuses to write it, with or without --bypass-setup-password, before SetVariable()

column3: . == {"error_message": "EFI variable EnhancedAuthData-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000000301 has authenticated access (attributes 0x87), which uefisettings does not write"}
. == {"error_message": "EFI variable EnhancedAuthData-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000000301 has authenticated access (attributes 0x87), which uefisettings does not write"}
. == {"error_message": "EFI variable EnhancedAuthData-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000000301 has authenticated access (attributes 0x87), which uefisettings does not write"}

column1: # and the variable stays as it was
# the firmware holds the attributes and size that the scenario seeds
# get names the check that refuses the metadata of Version 2

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "<ValueUnavailable: EFI variable EnhancedAuthRefused-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000000301 has enhanced authenticated access (attributes 0x87), whose metadata uefisettings refuses: EFI_VARIABLE_AUTHENTICATION_3 Version 2, not 1>"
